name: settings-routing-reads-as-sentences
description: the Routing pane reads as sentence cards, not the old engine-styled rows. Opens Settings, selects the Routing pane by its rail id, and reads the DOM the routing-as-sentences redress produced: one '.routing-card[data-rule-id]' per rule under '.routing-sentences', plus a last '.routing-card.routing-fallback' holding 'select[name="defaultTargetSpaceID"]'. No routing fixture is staged, so the store loads its empty defaults - the fallback card must still be there on a fresh profile.

actions.note: gate: the startup tab committed, so the app is up
Atrium must be frontmost or cmd+comma opens Finder Settings instead
the pane's data source loaded before the pane is asked to read it

actions.expression: (() => { const item = document.querySelector('.settings-rail-item[data-pane="routing"]'); if (!item) { return 'no routing rail item'; } item.click(); return 'clicked'; })()

actions.note: renderRoutingPane is a synchronous DOM rebuild, slack for the ssh/eval round trip
evidence: sentence cards with the dashed fallback card last

assertions.desc: a fresh, ruleless profile still shows the fallback card
the fallback card holds the default-target-space select
the browser window and the settings window
